content.comment_body: I'm trying to connect a PC using Node-red and an HMI panel to a [product_name] module. Each connection works independently, but when both devices connect at the same time, strange behavior occurs. Is there a parameter I might have missed?
It seems that Node-red and the HMI panel are sharing the same type of connection. If I were you, I'd consider submitting a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report problems when connecting both a PC running Node-red and an HMI panel simultaneously to a [product_name] module. While each device works fine individually, trying to use both together leads to unstable or unpredictable outcomes, indicating potential conflicts or limitations in how the module manages network or protocol connections.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect both the PC (Node-red) and the HMI panel to be able to connect and operate reliably with the [product_name] module at the same time, without interference or unexpected issues.
pain_keywords: cannot use both interfaces at once
